measurement_note: Size scales both n and m. Legal tiers 4, 16, and 64 span 16x; every condition is false and the pattern is a run of a characters ending in b, so all automaton states and forbidden-match checks are exercised while the all-a answer remains valid. The accepted precomputed KMP-transition feasibility DP is O((n + m)m). A correct baseline that recomputes each automaton transition by direct suffix comparison is O((n + m)m^2), must return every expected answer, and must fail only scaling.
